demo.label: Demo mode
demo.offline: Sample chargers from a built-in test network. Nothing is sent anywhere, nothing charges and no card is charged.
demo.server: The server is in demo mode, with sample chargers from a mock CPO. Nothing charges and no card is charged.
nav.label: Main
map.locateDenied: Location is off. Turn it on in your settings to find chargers near you.
map.unavailable: The map can't be shown on this device. The list has every charger.
search.label: Search chargers
filters.label: Filters
results.emptyBody: Try fewer filters or another search.
price.displayOnly: You pay what the charger's operator bills for your session.
detail.title: Charger
detail.notFound: This charger is no longer listed.
account.title: Account
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: No password needed. We email you a code.
signIn.sent: If {email} can sign in, a code is on its way. It can take a minute to arrive.
signIn.demoHint: Demo: no email is sent. Use the code {code}.
signIn.errorCodeFormat: Enter the code from the email: 6 to 10 digits.
signIn.errorCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
signIn.errorRateLimited: Too many tries. Try again in {minutes} min.
signIn.errorUnreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
charging.title: Charging
charging.body: Scan the charger's QR code or enter its ID, or find one on the map.
wallet.title: Wallet
start.title: Start charging
start.scanBody: Point the camera at the code on the charger.
start.cameraLabel: Camera, looking for the charger's QR code
start.cameraDenied: The camera is off for this app. Turn it on in your settings, or enter the charger's ID below.
start.codeHint: It's printed on the charger, for example ZZ*MCK*E11 or A1.
start.badCode: That doesn't look like a charger's ID. Check the code on the charger.
start.notFound: No charger found for {code}. Check the ID, or find the charger on the map.
start.error: Couldn't look up the charger. Try again.
start.problem.card: Your card wasn't approved for the hold, so the charger wasn't started. Choose another card in Wallet.
start.problem.notSupported: This charger doesn't accept starts from the app. Nothing was charged.
start.problem.occupied: This charger is in use. Nothing was charged; try another connector.
start.problem.inoperative: This charger is out of order. Nothing was charged; try another charger.
start.problem.timedOut: The charger didn't answer. If it isn't charging, nothing is charged.
start.problem.failed: The charger couldn't start. Nothing was charged; try again.
start.problem.blocked: This account can't charge right now. Contact support.
confirm.title: Confirm and start
confirm.needCard: Add a card in Wallet before you charge.
confirm.holdNote: Before the charger starts, we hold this amount on your card. You pay what the operator bills for the session, never more than the hold; the rest is released.
confirm.raiseNote: On a long session the hold may be raised where your card allows it. If your card doesn't approve more, charging stops.
confirm.demo: Demo: no card is charged and nothing is sent to a charger.
confirm.noPayments: This network takes no app payments in this charger's currency.
charge.title: Your charge
charge.costSoFar: Cost so far, as the operator reports it
charge.costFinal: Cost, as the operator reported it
charge.costUnknown: The operator hasn't shared the cost yet
charge.stopFailed: The charger didn't stop. Try again, or stop it at the charger.
charge.stopTooSoon: The session is still starting. Try again in a moment.
charge.declined: Your card didn't approve more charging; session stopped at {amount}.
charge.declinedShort: Stopped: your card didn't approve more charging
charge.declinedNext: Nothing more will be charged. The charger is fine: to charge again, choose another card in Wallet.
charge.finishedBody: Your receipt follows once the operator sends the final bill.
history.title: Recent charging
favourites.title: Favourites
receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.demo: Demo receipt: no card was charged.
receipt.released: Nothing was charged: the hold on your card has been released.
receipt.shortfall: The session cost more than the hold. Only {amount} was charged; the rest is not charged automatically.
receipt.review: Our team is checking this payment. Nothing more is charged without telling you.
receipt.notReady: The receipt isn't ready yet. It comes when the charger's operator sends the final bill, usually within minutes.
receipt.emailed: We've emailed the receipt to you.
receipt.emailLimited: You've asked for a few emails already. Try again later.
receipt.emailOff: Email receipts aren't set up on this network.
receipt.emailFailed: Couldn't send the email. Try again.
report.title: Report a problem
report.signIn: Sign in to report a problem.
report.photoHint: A photo helps the operator fix it. We send a smaller copy, without its location data.
report.photoFailed: Couldn't use that photo. Try another one.
report.photoTooLarge: The photo is too large. Choose a smaller one.
report.cameraDenied: The camera is off for this app. Turn it on in your settings, or choose a photo.
report.needMessage: Tell us a little about the problem.
report.failed: Couldn't send the report. Try again.
report.limited: You've sent many reports today. Try again tomorrow.
report.thanks: Your report went to the network's support team.
wallet.signIn: Sign in to see your cards and receipts.
wallet.noCards: No card saved yet. Add one to charge.
wallet.addFailed: Couldn't save the card. Try again.
wallet.addOnPhone: Add cards in the phone app. Here you can choose and remove them.
wallet.loadError: Couldn't load your wallet. Check your connection.
wallet.demoNote: Demo: two demo cards, nothing is charged. The Mastercard declines a higher hold, to show what happens then.
wallet.demoAdd: Demo: no card is saved. Use the demo cards.
wallet.demoRemove: Demo: the demo cards can't be removed.
wallet.stripeNote: Cards are saved by Stripe for this network. The app and the network never see the full number.
account.notificationsOn: On: we tell you when charging finishes or a charger doesn't respond.
account.notificationsOff: Off. Turn them on to hear when charging finishes.
account.notificationsDenied: Notifications are off for this app. Turn them on in your phone's settings.
account.notificationsWeb: The web app has no notifications. The Charging tab shows the news while it's open.
account.notificationsUnavailable: Notifications aren't available on this device.
common.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
charging.signIn: Sign in to start charging, see your sessions and your receipts.
charging.loadError: Couldn't load your charging. Check your connection and open this tab again.
